title: Relative clauses 2: clauses with and without who/that/which

exercises.instruction: In some of these sentences you need who or that. Correct the sentences where necessary.

items.prompt: The woman lives next door is a doctor.
answers: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.

items.prompt: Did you find the keys you lost?
The people we met last night were very friendly.
answers: The people who/that we met last night were very friendly.

items.prompt: The people work in the office are very friendly.
answers: The people who/that work in the office are very friendly.

items.prompt: I like the people I work with.
answers: I like the people who/that I work with.

items.prompt: What have you done with the money I gave you?
answers: What have you done with the money that/which I gave you?

items.prompt: What happened to the money was on the table?
answers: What happened to the money that/which was on the table?

items.prompt: What’s the worst film you’ve ever seen?
answers: What’s the worst film that/which you’ve ever seen?

items.prompt: What’s the best thing it has ever happened to you?
answers: What’s the best thing that/which has ever happened to you?
